name: Attack — Melee
notes: The attacker's player rolls Dexterity + the Ability that governs the kind of attack (p.228). The weapon's accuracy is added to the Dexterity + Ability total when rolling for attacks (p.327). Armour's mobility penalty does NOT normally apply to attack rolls (p.332).

name: Attack — Brawl
notes: Characters attacking unarmed may choose Martial Arts or Brawl; the difference is description and the Charms available (p.228).

name: Attack — Martial Arts
notes: Characters attacking unarmed may choose Martial Arts or Brawl (p.228).

name: Attack — Archery
notes: The bow's accuracy is added to or subtracted from the Dexterity + Archery total when rolling for attacks (p.330). Range penalties are situational and are NOT included here.

name: Attack — Thrown
notes: Accuracy is added to or subtracted from the Dexterity + Thrown total when rolling for attacks (p.331). Range penalties are situational and are NOT included here.

name: Parry — Melee
notes: Parry rolls are Dexterity + whatever Ability governs the weapon the character is armed with (p.228); the weapon's defense is added to that total when she parries with it (p.327). The mobility penalty does not normally apply to parry rolls (p.332).

name: Dodge
notes: Dodge rolls are Dexterity + Dodge (p.228). The armour mobility penalty DOES apply to dodge rolls (p.332). The cumulative -1, -2… for dodging repeated attacks in one turn is situational and is not included here.

name: Athletics — whole-body feat
notes: The mobility penalty applies to Athletics rolls for feats that require whole-body agility (p.332). Which Attribute an Athletics roll uses varies with the feat — build a custom pool for anything that is not Dexterity-based.

name: Fatigue roll (armour)
notes: Players must make a Stamina + Endurance roll when their characters wear armour, at a difficulty equal to the armour's fatigue value (p.332). The difficulty is not a dice-pool term, so it is shown beside the pool rather than in it.

name: Resist infection
notes: A reflexive Stamina + Resistance roll to resist infection (p.233). "Wound penalties do not subtract from the character's dice pool for the purposes of this roll" — the only printed exemption in the shipped catalogue, so the wound line is omitted here even when the character is hurt.

name: Virtue check
notes: A character with 3 or more dots in a Virtue must roll his Virtue rating when he wishes to act contrary to that Virtue's dictates (p.130). The pool is the Virtue rating alone.

name: Willpower check
notes: Dice actions using Willpower are based on the character's PERMANENT score (the dots), not the current temporary rating (the squares) — p.88.
